title: Living across from the halls; schools and Xavier
summary: He lived opposite the halls, heard players like Piron, and lists the schools he attended through 1934 and a year at Xavier.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: As a matter of fact, I used to stay right across the street from there, so therefore I had access to the places at various times of the day, and where I'd get a chance to listen to some of the fellas playing and whatnot. And I think it was one of these halls, which when I don't remember, that I got a chance to see some of the guys that were more or less inspiring to me. And one particular fella I had in mind was this Alphonse Piku. However I never had a chance to study under Piku because at that particular time things were pretty rough and conditions were very bad. And the overall conditions just was bad and the only thing about it, the inspiration was there, and from time to time I just got to see and listen to various groups that used to participate over there until I was able to go to school and learn music.
Now where did you go to school? Which school did you go to school?

Well, at that time I went to, I started out at St. Mary's Academy, which was a unit comprised of girls and boys, but later the boys entered the place, was transferred to a little school on St. Bernard Street. Of course I understand that school is there no more, but it was just more or less temporary until they could find a better site.
St. Mary's was down to the cathedral?

That's right, right about, just about a half block from the St. Louis Cathedral. Then from there I went to a Gugman Nicholas School on Gugman Nicholas, and later went to Joseph A. Craig School. And from there I went to Albert Wicker, left Albert Wicker and went to McDonald's 35 and graduated in high school in 1934 I think it was, yes.
Were you a Catholic I suppose?
Yes, I was born and really Catholic. And I left there and went to Xavier University for about a year. And I had hoped to go back, but for some particular reason I just never did get back.
